surprises.description: Ecolab delivered 7% organic sales growth, above the preview’s 6.0–6.5% consensus range and at the top of the company’s 6–7% H2 guide. This was a modest upside versus the expected acceleration.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Ecolab delivered 7% organic sales growth in Q3 2026.”

surprises.description: Organic operating income margin reached 19.6%, above the preview’s roughly 19% adjusted-margin expectation. The preview anticipated margin improvement, but the reported level was better than that benchmark.
surprises.expectation_evidence: “Adj. operating margin | ~19%”; the preview also described the margin bridge as targeting “~19% adjusted / ~20% organic.”

surprises.description: Institutional & Specialty had slightly declining volume, weaker than the preview’s expectation that growth below roughly 3% would be a concern. North American restaurant foot traffic was down mid-single digits, but the preview had highlighted the segment’s prior 4% growth despite similar traffic pressure.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Institutional & Specialty was the weak spot with slightly declining volume amid North American restaurant foot traffic falling mid-single digits.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: “If this decelerates below ~3%, the ‘defensive ballast’ part of the story cracks”; the preview also noted Institutional & Specialty “grew 4% in Q2 despite restaurant foot traffic down 5%.”

surprises.description: CoolIT’s financing and amortization burden was quantified at roughly 10% of Q3 EPS and is expected to rise to about 12% in Q4. The preview acknowledged the drag but called for confirmation that it had not grown, so the further increase into Q4 is a negative development.
surprises.fact_evidence: “CoolIT … carried an interest/amortization drag of roughly 10% on EPS in Q3, expected to rise to about 12% in Q4 due to an extra month from reporting lag.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: “Management has already pre-flagged the CoolIT amortization/financing hit inside the FY guide — confirm it hasn't grown.”

surprises.description: Management said elevated commodity costs are expected to persist through the end of 2027, extending the cost-pressure outlook beyond the preview’s expectation of high-single-digit inflation for the remainder of 2026. That longer duration is a negative change even though pricing is running at the expected level.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Pricing is running at 5%-6% … to offset elevated commodity costs expected to persist through end of 2027.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview described “high-single-digit commodity inflation for the remainder of 2026.”

surprises.description: Ecolab Digital sales rose 34%, a strong reported growth rate that the preview did not discuss or set an expectation for. This is a positive, newly surfaced operating result.

Pest Elimination accelerated to 8% growth, and management reported that Pest Intelligence connects over 800,000 devices and delivers nearly 99% pest-free results versus a 94% industry standard. The preview did not provide a Pest growth or performance expectation.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Pest Elimination accelerated to 8% growth, with Pest Intelligence now connecting over 800,000 devices and delivering nearly 99% pest-free results versus the 94% industry standard.”
